summary: Canaan Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its August 2026 bitcoin production and mining update. The company sold 3,952 ETH at about US$2,400 each and 54 BTC at about US$79,000 each, generating roughly US$13.9 million, and used part of the proceeds to repurchase approximately 13.6 million ADSs, bringing year-to-date buybacks to about 16.4 million ADSs. It mined 44 BTC in August, held 1,868 BTC and zero ETH at month-end, and operates 10.05 EH/s non-JV plus 4.92 EH/s JV installed hashrate. No board recommendation or advisor was named; the treasury conversion and buyback are the capital-return mechanics to watch.
